tables.caption: TABLE I. Properties of ∼ 30 nm thick Al2O3 films deposited at different temperatures on native oxide covered c -Si substrates using two different TMAdosing conditions in the PA-ALD cycle. The growth rate is determined from in situ SE; the mass density and film composition are determined from RBS. The first row gives the typical absolute errors on the results.
tables.markdown:
TABLE I. Properties of ∼ 30 nm thick Al2O3 films deposited at different temperatures on native oxide covered c -Si substrates using two different TMAdosing conditions in the PA-ALD cycle. The growth rate is determined from in situ SE; the mass density and film composition are determined from RBS. The first row gives the typical absolute errors on the results.
